name: intana-viz
description: Visualize intelligence analysis and structured analytic techniques in draw.io. Use for hypothesis comparison, argument maps, decision or risk matrices, stakeholder analysis, assumption checks, premortems, wargaming, and root-cause diagrams. Selects from 80+ techniques when the user needs an analytical visual, even without naming the technique.
